profile.headline: Software Engineer at Gozynta
profile.summary: Passionate back-end developer with 9 years of experience leading the design, development, and maintenance of high-quality and reliable products in diverse industries. In-depth experience using Python, PHP, REST API, MySQL, MongoDB and other technologies to achieve outstanding results. Being committed to deadlines with creative skills to solve problems and resolve issues.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · FastAPI · Flask · MySQL · MongoDB · Vue · Kubernetes · QuickBooks · Software Industry · Chargebee · Redis · SendGrid · BridgeComm

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed the web services for Digicall mobile application. It is an electrical catalogue in Ipad that Urgo Medical Representatives will use to promote Urgo products to customers during their marketing activity or events. 
- Designed and developed Monexion application. It is an application that allows friends or roommates to manage their accounts and refunds more easily.
- Created and implemented back-end, cooperate with IOs team, Android team, Design team, QA team to make sure the product had the best quality when delivering to customer
- Proactively monitor services, review product quality, make builds and deploy them to the production server.
Technical: PHP, mySQL, Apache Web server, Linux, Cakephp, Zend framework, jQuery, Ajax, Json, XML, Payline

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed online language learning system
- Participated in implementing front-end, back-end, manual test
Technical: PHP, MySQL, Apache Web server, Linux, Zend framework, jQuery, Ajax, Json, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery, Paypal, MoneyBookers

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed dealer management portal, the system provides the ability to manage the life cycle of Dealers, Agents and their related entities such as Users, Markets and Contracts,..
- Technical: PHP, MySQL, Apache Web server, Linux, Zend framework, jQuery, Ajax, Json, HTML, CSS

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Successfully built several Web applications from ground up. 
- Participated as senior developer, team leader of several Web applications such as: Diagonal Cinema Website (manage films, news, schedules events,..) , Allbrain project (for providing healthcare news and scheduling diet food selection), Xtranet project (for managing company documentation), - Tropicana project (ticket booking system for Grand slam tennis cup)
- Built several content management systems for Rousselot, Bates141, Sodexo.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed a Web application for a hospital to make plans for its employees.
- Designed and Developed a Web application for managing employee salaries, creating reports for a company
- Designed and developed a web solution that provides common features to help the customers can order food online.
- Analyzed business requirements, design, create tasks, lead team, build and deploy to production server.
Technical: ASP.NET, C#, MS SQL 2000 server, IIS,  PHP, mySQL, Apache Web server, Linux, HTML, CSS
